title: Pixabay Visuals
description: Preview-first Pixabay image/video search with a 24-hour provider response cache. The API key stays machine-local.

media_type.title: Media type
media_type.description: Search videos by default; use images or both when a scene benefits from stills.

per_query.title: Candidates per query
per_query.description: Pixabay requires at least 3 results per page.

orientation.title: Orientation
orientation.description: Auto derives horizontal/vertical from SceneIntent; square scenes use all orientations.

safe_search.title: Safe search
safe_search.description: Request only results suitable for all ages.

api_key_env.title: API key environment variable
api_key_env.description: Name of the machine-local environment variable containing the Pixabay API key. The secret value is never stored in OmniCreator project data.
